public import transactions = "./transactions.qui"

string header_text(int height, string previous, string merkle, int timestamp, int difficulty, int nonce)
    return "{height}|{previous}|{merkle}|{timestamp}|{difficulty}|{nonce}"

class Block(int height, string previous, string merkle, int timestamp, int difficulty, int nonce, transactions.Transaction[] txs)
    hash := transactions.wallets.hashing.digest(header_text(height, previous, merkle, timestamp, difficulty, nonce))

    int size()
        amount := 0
        for index := (1:<int(#txs))[]
            amount += txs[index].size
        return amount

    string[] txids()
        return [for transaction := txs[] then transaction.txid]

bool meets_difficulty(string hash, int difficulty)
    return hash.starts_with("0" * nat(difficulty))

Block parse_block_event(string[] fields, string[] texts)
    return Block(int(fields[3]), fields[4], fields[5], int(fields[6]), int(fields[7]), int(fields[8]), [for text := texts[] then transactions.parse_transaction(text)])

Block mine_block(int height, string previous, transactions.Transaction[] payments, int timestamp, int difficulty)
    merkle := transactions.wallets.hashing.merkle_root([for transaction := payments[] then transaction.txid])
    nonce := 0
    while not meets_difficulty(transactions.wallets.hashing.digest(header_text(height, previous, merkle, timestamp, difficulty, nonce)), difficulty)
        nonce += 1
    return Block(height, previous, merkle, timestamp, difficulty, nonce, payments)

string context_free_error(Block block, int maximum)
    if not meets_difficulty(block.hash, block.difficulty)
        return "bad-pow"
    if transactions.wallets.hashing.merkle_root(block.txids()) != block.merkle
        return "bad-merkle"
    first := block.txs[0]
    if not first.is_coinbase() or first.coinbase_height != block.height
        return "bad-structure"
    for index := (1:<int(#block.txs))[]
        if block.txs[index].is_coinbase()
            return "bad-structure"
    return if block.size() > maximum then "too-large" else ""

import math
public import blocks = "./blocks.qui"

class Record(blocks.Block block, int parent, map<string, blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo, int[] transaction_fees, string source, int cumulative_work)
    fees := transaction_fees.sum()
    int height := block.height
    string hash := block.hash

int reward(int height, int initial, int interval)
    amount := initial
    for _ < height / interval
        amount /= 2
    return amount

int ancestor(Record[] records, int start, int height)
    cursor := start
    while records[cursor].height > height
        cursor = records[cursor].parent
    return cursor

int[] chain_to(Record[] records, int start)
    int[] reverse := []
    cursor := start
    while cursor >= 0
        reverse = reverse.append(cursor)
        cursor = records[cursor].parent
    return reverse[::-1]

int fork_point(Record[] records, int first, int second)
    height := math.min(records[first].height, records[second].height)
    left := ancestor(records, first, height)
    right := ancestor(records, second, height)
    while left != right
        left = records[left].parent
        right = records[right].parent
    return left

int median_time(Record[] records, int start)
    int[] times := []
    cursor := start
    while cursor >= 0 and #times < 3
        times = times.append(records[cursor].block.timestamp)
        cursor = records[cursor].parent
    return times.sorted()[(#times - 1) / 2]

int required_difficulty(Record[] records, int parent, int initial, int interval, int target)
    height := records[parent].height + 1
    difficulty := records[parent].block.difficulty
    if height == 1
        return initial
    if height % interval != 0
        return difficulty
    first := ancestor(records, parent, height - interval)
    span := records[parent].block.timestamp - records[first].block.timestamp
    expected := target * (interval - 1)
    if 2 * span < expected
        return math.min(difficulty + 1, 2)
    return if span > 2 * expected then math.max(difficulty - 1, 0) else difficulty

string hex8(int number)
    low := nat(number % 4294967296)
    hex := low.b16
    return "0" * (8 - #hex) + hex

string digest(string text)
    bases := [1000003, 1500007, 2750159, 4194301]
    initials := [11, 23, 37, 53]
    result := ""
    for: lane < 4
        value := initials[lane]
        for code := text.codepoints()[]
            value = (value * bases[lane] + code) % 2147483647
        for extra := [int(#text), 0, 0][]
            value = (value * bases[lane] + extra) % 2147483647
        result += hex8(value)
    return result

string merkle_root(string[] hashes)
    level := hashes
    while #level > 1
        if #level % 2 == 1
            level = level.append(level[-1])
        string[] next_level := []
        for: 0 <= position < int(#level) step 2
            next_level = next_level.append(digest(level[position] + level[position + 1]))
        level = next_level
    return level[0]

string short(string value)
    return value[0:<8]

import math
import chain = "./chain.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

class Params(local string[][] rows)
    initial_difficulty := int(rows[0][1])
    retarget_interval := int(rows[1][1])
    target_spacing := int(rows[1][2])
    initial_reward := int(rows[2][1])
    halving_interval := int(rows[2][2])
    maturity := int(rows[3][1])
    max_block_size := int(rows[4][1])
    min_fee_rate := int(rows[5][1])
    mempool_limit := int(rows[6][1])
    orphan_limit := int(rows[7][1])
    drift := int(rows[8][1])
    expiry := int(rows[9][1])
    max_reorg := int(rows[10][1])
    ban_score := int(rows[11][1])
    block_penalty := int(rows[11][2])
    tx_penalty := int(rows[11][3])
    string[] genesis := rows[12][1:]

class Peer(string name)
    accepted_blocks := 0
    rejected_blocks := 0
    orphaned_blocks := 0
    accepted_txs := 0
    rejected_txs := 0
    ignored := 0
    score := 0

class MempoolEntry(chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction transaction, int fee, int arrival, returned := false)
class Orphan(chain.blocks.Block block, int peer)
class Reorganization(int moment, int fork_height, int disconnected, int connected, string old_hash, string new_hash)
class Acceptance(string reason, fee := 0, string[] conflicts := [])
class Validation(string reason, map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo, int[] fees)

bool text_before(string first, string second)
    values := [first, second].sorted()
    return first != second and values[0] == first

bool priority_before(MempoolEntry first, MempoolEntry second)
    int left := first.fee * second.transaction.size
    int right := second.fee * first.transaction.size
    return left > right or (left == right and text_before(first.transaction.txid, second.transaction.txid))

bool reference_before(string first, string second)
    left := first.split(":")
    right := second.split(":")
    left_index := int(left[1])
    right_index := int(right[1])
    return text_before(left[0], right[0]) or (left[0] == right[0] and left_index < right_index)

string signed(int value)
    return if value >= 0 then "+{value}" else "{value}"

class Node(Params params, chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet[] managed)
    owners := map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet>()
    named := map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet>()
    chain.Record[] records := []
    record_index := map<string, int>()
    tip := 0
    now := 0
    int[] main_chain := []
    map<string, int> confirmed
    MempoolEntry[] mempool := []
    Orphan[] orphans := []
    rejected := distinct<string>()
    drop_record := map<string, string>()
    Peer[] peers := []
    peer_index := map<string, int>()
    rejections := map<string, int>()
    Reorganization[] reorganizations := []
    string[] log_lines := []

    for wallet := managed[]
        .owners.set(wallet.address, wallet)
        .named.set(wallet.name, wallet)
    local chain.blocks.transactions.Output[] initial_outputs := []
    for: 0 <= position < int(#params.genesis) step 2
        local chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet destination := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(named, params.genesis[position])
        initial_outputs = initial_outputs.append(chain.blocks.transactions.Output(destination.address, int(params.genesis[position + 1])))
    local chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction genesis_tx := chain.blocks.transactions.create_coinbase(0, initial_outputs)
    local genesis_block := chain.blocks.Block(0, "0" * 32, genesis_tx.txid, 0, 0, 0, [genesis_tx])
    local map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> genesis_utxo
    chain.blocks.transactions.apply_transaction(&genesis_utxo, genesis_tx, 0)
    records = [chain.Record(genesis_block, -1, genesis_utxo, [], "genesis", 1)]
    .record_index.set(genesis_block.hash, 0)
    .refresh()

    void .refresh()
        main_chain = chain.chain_to(records, tip)
        confirmed = map<string, int>()
        for index := main_chain[]
            for payment := records[index].block.txs[]
                .confirmed.set(payment.txid, records[index].height)

    void .log(string text)
        log_lines = log_lines.append("{now} " + text)

    void .tally(string category, string reason)
        key := category + " " + reason
        count := 0
        if rejections.has(key)
            count = chain.blocks.transactions.entry(rejections, key)
        .rejections.set(key, count + 1)

    int .peer(string name)
        if not peer_index.has(name)
            .peer_index.set(name, int(#peers))
            peers = peers.append(Peer(name))
        return chain.blocks.transactions.entry(peer_index, name)

    int next_height()
        return records[tip].height + 1

    int reward(int height)
        return chain.reward(height, params.initial_reward, params.halving_interval)

    int difficulty(int parent)
        return chain.required_difficulty(records, parent, params.initial_difficulty, params.retarget_interval, params.target_spacing)

    bool mature(chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin)
        return coin.mature(next_height(), params.maturity)

    distinct<string> locked()
        distinct<string> result
        for pending := mempool[]
            for reference := pending.transaction.inputs[]
                .result.add(reference)
        return result

    MempoolEntry[] priority()
        MempoolEntry[] ranked := []
        for pending := mempool[]
            position := int(#ranked)
            ranked = ranked.append(pending)
            while position > 0 and priority_before(pending, ranked[position - 1])
                ranked[position] = ranked[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            ranked[position] = pending
        return ranked

    int find_entry(string txid)
        for: index < int(#mempool)
            if mempool[index].transaction.txid == txid
                return index
        return -1

    Acceptance acceptance(chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment)
        if payment.is_coinbase()
            return Acceptance("coinbase")
        if confirmed.has(payment.txid) or find_entry(payment.txid) >= 0
            return Acceptance("duplicate")
        distinct<string> spent
        chain.blocks.transactions.Check result := chain.blocks.transactions.check_transaction(payment, records[tip].utxo, spent, next_height(), owners, params.maturity)
        if result.reason != ""
            return Acceptance(result.reason)
        if result.fee * 1000 < params.min_fee_rate * payment.size
            return Acceptance("low-fee")
        string[] conflicts := []
        total := 0
        higher_rate := true
        for pending := mempool[]
            conflict := false
            for reference := pending.transaction.inputs[]
                for candidate := payment.inputs[]
                    if reference == candidate
                        conflict = true
            if conflict
                conflicts = conflicts.append(pending.transaction.txid)
                total += pending.fee
                if result.fee * pending.transaction.size <= pending.fee * payment.size
                    higher_rate = false
        if #conflicts > 0 and (result.fee <= total or not higher_rate)
            return Acceptance("conflict")
        return Acceptance("", result.fee, conflicts)

    void .record_drop(string txid, string reason)
        .drop_record.set(txid, reason)
        .log("DROP " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(txid) + " " + reason)

    void .drop(string txid, string reason)
        mempool = [for pending := mempool[] if pending.transaction.txid != txid then pending]
        .record_drop(txid, reason)

    void .register(chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment, Acceptance result, int arrival)
        for txid := result.conflicts[]
            .drop(txid, "replaced")
        mempool = mempool.append(MempoolEntry(payment, result.fee, arrival))
        if int(#mempool) > params.mempool_limit
            MempoolEntry[] ranked := priority()
            .drop(ranked[-1].transaction.txid, "mempool-full")

    void .rebuild(chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction[] returned)
        previous := mempool
        mempool = []
        MempoolEntry[] candidates := [for payment := returned[] then MempoolEntry(payment, 0, now, true)].concat(previous)
        for candidate := candidates[]
            payment := candidate.transaction
            if confirmed.has(payment.txid)
                continue
            Acceptance result := acceptance(payment)
            if result.reason != ""
                .record_drop(payment.txid, result.reason)
            else
                if candidate.returned
                    .log("RETURN " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(payment.txid))
                .register(payment, result, candidate.arrival)

    void .switch_tip(int target)
        old_tip := tip
        fork := chain.fork_point(records, tip, target)
        disconnected := records[tip].height - records[fork].height
        connected := records[target].height - records[fork].height
        candidate := records[target]
        fork_height := records[fork].height
        if disconnected > params.max_reorg
            .log("REFUSE {candidate.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(candidate.hash) + " work {candidate.cumulative_work} fork {fork_height} depth {disconnected}")
            return
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction[] returned := []
        for index := main_chain[fork_height + 1:][]
            returned = returned.concat(records[index].block.txs[1:])
        tip = target
        .refresh()
        if disconnected == 0
            .log("TIP {candidate.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(candidate.hash) + " work {candidate.cumulative_work}")
        else
            .log("REORG {candidate.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(candidate.hash) + " work {candidate.cumulative_work} fork {fork_height} disconnected {disconnected} connected {connected}")
            reorganizations = reorganizations.append(Reorganization(now, fork_height, disconnected, connected, records[old_tip].hash, candidate.hash))
        .rebuild(returned)

    void .penalize(int peer_number, int points)
        before := peers[peer_number].score
        peers[peer_number].score += points
        if before < params.ban_score and peers[peer_number].score >= params.ban_score
            .log("BAN {peers[peer_number].name} score {peers[peer_number].score}")

    void .pay(string[] fields)
        chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet sender := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(named, fields[2])
        fee := int(fields[3])
        chain.blocks.transactions.Output[] outputs := []
        total := 0
        for: 4 <= position < int(#fields) step 2
            chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet destination := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(named, fields[position])
            amount := int(fields[position + 1])
            outputs = outputs.append(chain.blocks.transactions.Output(destination.address, amount))
            total += amount
        prefix := "PAY {sender.name} fee {fee} total {total}"
        distinct<string> held := locked()
        string[] coins := []
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo := records[tip].utxo
        for reference := utxo.keys()[]
            chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(utxo, reference)
            if coin.address != sender.address or held.has(reference) or not mature(coin)
                continue
            position := int(#coins)
            coins = coins.append(reference)
            while position > 0
                previous_reference := coins[position - 1]
                chain.blocks.transactions.Coin previous_coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(utxo, previous_reference)
                if coin.amount < previous_coin.amount or (coin.amount == previous_coin.amount and not reference_before(reference, previous_reference))
                    break
                coins[position] = previous_reference
                position -= 1
            coins[position] = reference
        string[] inputs := []
        gathered := 0
        for reference := coins[]
            if gathered >= total + fee
                break
            inputs = inputs.append(reference)
            chain.blocks.transactions.Coin selected := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(utxo, reference)
            gathered += selected.amount
        if gathered < total + fee
            .log(prefix + " rejected insufficient-funds")
            .tally("pay", "insufficient-funds")
            return
        if gathered > total + fee
            outputs = outputs.append(chain.blocks.transactions.Output(sender.address, gathered - total - fee))
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment := chain.blocks.transactions.create_transaction(inputs, outputs, sender.secret)
        Acceptance result := acceptance(payment)
        prefix += " tx " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(payment.txid)
        if result.reason != ""
            .log(prefix + " rejected " + result.reason)
            .tally("pay", result.reason)
            return
        .log(prefix + " accepted inputs {#inputs} outputs {#outputs} size {payment.size}")
        .register(payment, result, now)

    void .bump(string txid, int fee)
        string prefix := "BUMP " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(txid) + " fee {fee}"
        int index := find_entry(txid)
        if index < 0
            .log(prefix + " rejected unknown")
            .tally("bump", "unknown")
            return
        pending := mempool[index]
        original := pending.transaction
        chain.blocks.transactions.Output[] outputs := original.outputs
        last := int(#outputs) - 1
        string address := outputs[last].address
        outputs[last].amount -= fee - pending.fee
        valid := outputs[last].amount >= 1
        for reference := original.inputs[]
            chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry<chain.blocks.transactions.Coin>(records[tip].utxo, reference)
            if coin.address != address
                valid = false
        if not valid
            .log(prefix + " rejected no-change")
            .tally("bump", "no-change")
            return
        chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet owner := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(owners, address)
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment := chain.blocks.transactions.create_transaction(original.inputs, outputs, owner.secret)
        Acceptance result := acceptance(payment)
        prefix += " tx " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(payment.txid)
        if result.reason != ""
            .log(prefix + " rejected " + result.reason)
            .tally("bump", result.reason)
            return
        .log(prefix + " accepted size {payment.size}")
        .register(payment, result, now)

    void .receive_transaction(int peer_number, chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment)
        Acceptance result := acceptance(payment)
        string prefix := "TX {peers[peer_number].name} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(payment.txid)
        if result.reason != ""
            peers[peer_number].rejected_txs += 1
            .tally("tx", result.reason)
            .log(prefix + " rejected " + result.reason)
            if result.reason == "coinbase" or result.reason == "bad-output" or result.reason == "bad-sig" or result.reason == "overspend"
                .penalize(peer_number, params.tx_penalty)
        else
            peers[peer_number].accepted_txs += 1
            .log(prefix + " accepted fee {result.fee} size {payment.size}")
            .register(payment, result, now)

    void .mine(chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet wallet)
        int height := next_height()
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction[] payments := []
        int[] fees := []
        size := 0
        for pending := priority()[]
            if size + pending.transaction.size <= params.max_block_size
                payments = payments.append(pending.transaction)
                fees = fees.append(pending.fee)
                size += pending.transaction.size
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction coinbase := chain.blocks.transactions.create_coinbase(height, [chain.blocks.transactions.Output(wallet.address, reward(height) + fees.sum())])
        payments = [coinbase].concat(payments)
        chain.blocks.Block block := chain.blocks.mine_block(height, records[tip].hash, payments, math.max(now, chain.median_time(records, tip) + 1), difficulty(tip))
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo := records[tip].utxo
        for payment := payments[]
            chain.blocks.transactions.apply_transaction(&utxo, payment, height)
        int work := records[tip].cumulative_work + 16 ^ block.difficulty
        records = records.append(chain.Record(block, tip, utxo, fees, "local", work))
        index := int(#records) - 1
        .record_index.set(block.hash, index)
        .log("MINE {wallet.name} {height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.hash) + " bits {block.difficulty} nonce {block.nonce} txs {#payments} size {size} fees {fees.sum()} work {work}")
        .switch_tip(index)

    void .reject_block(string kind, chain.blocks.Block block, int peer_number, string reason)
        .rejected.add(block.hash)
        peers[peer_number].rejected_blocks += 1
        .tally("block", reason.split(" ")[0])
        .log("{kind} {peers[peer_number].name} {block.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.hash) + " rejected " + reason)
        if reason != "time-too-new"
            .penalize(peer_number, params.block_penalty)

    Validation validate(chain.blocks.Block block, int parent)
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo := records[parent].utxo
        int[] fees := []
        if block.height != records[parent].height + 1
            return Validation("bad-height", utxo, fees)
        if block.difficulty != difficulty(parent)
            return Validation("bad-difficulty", utxo, fees)
        if block.timestamp <= chain.median_time(records, parent)
            return Validation("time-too-old", utxo, fees)
        if block.timestamp > now + params.drift
            return Validation("time-too-new", utxo, fees)
        distinct<string> spent
        for: 1 <= position < int(#block.txs)
            chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment := block.txs[position]
            chain.blocks.transactions.Check result := chain.blocks.transactions.check_transaction(payment, utxo, spent, block.height, owners, params.maturity)
            if result.reason != ""
                return Validation(result.reason + " tx {position + 1}", utxo, fees)
            for reference := payment.inputs[]
                .spent.add(reference)
            chain.blocks.transactions.apply_transaction(&utxo, payment, block.height)
            fees = fees.append(result.fee)
        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction coinbase := block.txs[0]
        for output := coinbase.outputs[]
            if not owners.has(output.address) or output.amount == 0
                return Validation("bad-output tx 1", utxo, fees)
        if coinbase.output_total() > reward(block.height) + fees.sum()
            return Validation("bad-coinbase", utxo, fees)
        chain.blocks.transactions.apply_transaction(&utxo, coinbase, block.height)
        return Validation("", utxo, fees)

    void .connect(string kind, chain.blocks.Block block, int peer_number)
        int parent := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(record_index, block.previous)
        Validation result := validate(block, parent)
        if result.reason != ""
            .reject_block(kind, block, peer_number, result.reason)
            return
        int work := records[parent].cumulative_work + 16 ^ block.difficulty
        records = records.append(chain.Record(block, parent, result.utxo, result.fees, peers[peer_number].name, work))
        index := int(#records) - 1
        .record_index.set(block.hash, index)
        peers[peer_number].accepted_blocks += 1
        .log("{kind} {peers[peer_number].name} {block.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.hash) + " accepted work {work}")
        if work > records[tip].cumulative_work
            .switch_tip(index)

    void .resolve(string start)
        queue := [start]
        head := 0
        while head < int(#queue)
            parent_hash := queue[head]
            head += 1
            children := [for orphan := orphans[] if orphan.block.previous == parent_hash then orphan]
            orphans = [for orphan := orphans[] if orphan.block.previous != parent_hash then orphan]
            for orphan := children[]
                if rejected.has(parent_hash)
                    .reject_block("UNORPHAN", orphan.block, orphan.peer, "bad-parent")
                else
                    .connect("UNORPHAN", orphan.block, orphan.peer)
                queue = queue.append(orphan.block.hash)

    void .receive_block(int peer_number, chain.blocks.Block block)
        duplicate := record_index.has(block.hash) or rejected.has(block.hash)
        for orphan := orphans[]
            if orphan.block.hash == block.hash
                duplicate = true
        string prefix := "BLOCK {peers[peer_number].name} {block.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.hash)
        if duplicate
            .log(prefix + " rejected duplicate")
            peers[peer_number].rejected_blocks += 1
            .tally("block", "duplicate")
            return
        string reason := chain.blocks.context_free_error(block, params.max_block_size)
        if reason == "" and rejected.has(block.previous)
            reason = "bad-parent"
        if reason != ""
            .reject_block("BLOCK", block, peer_number, reason)
            .resolve(block.hash)
            return
        if not record_index.has(block.previous)
            orphans = orphans.append(Orphan(block, peer_number))
            peers[peer_number].orphaned_blocks += 1
            .log(prefix + " orphan parent " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.previous))
            if int(#orphans) > params.orphan_limit
                .log("EVICT " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(orphans[0].block.hash) + " orphan-limit")
                orphans = orphans[1:]
            return
        .connect("BLOCK", block, peer_number)
        .resolve(block.hash)

    void .status(string txid)
        string prefix := "STATUS " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(txid)
        if confirmed.has(txid)
            int height := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(confirmed, txid)
            .log(prefix + " confirmed {height} confirmations {next_height() - height}")
            return
        MempoolEntry[] ranked := priority()
        for: rank < int(#ranked)
            if ranked[rank].transaction.txid == txid
                .log(prefix + " mempool rank {rank + 1} of {#ranked}")
                return
        if drop_record.has(txid)
            string reason := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(drop_record, txid)
            .log(prefix + " dropped " + reason)
            return
        for record := records[]
            for payment := record.block.txs[]
                if payment.txid == txid
                    .log(prefix + " stale")
                    return
        .log(prefix + " unknown")

    int balance(string address)
        total := 0
        for coin := records[tip].utxo.values()[]
            if coin.address == address
                total += coin.amount
        return total

    void .print_state()
        MempoolEntry[] ranked := priority()
        size := 0
        for pending := ranked[]
            size += pending.transaction.size
        head := records[tip]
        .log("PRINT height {head.height} tip " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(head.hash) + " work {head.cumulative_work} bits {difficulty(tip)} reward {reward(next_height())} mempool {#ranked} size {size} orphans {#orphans}")
        for: rank < int(#ranked)
            pending := ranked[rank]
            .log("MEMPOOL {rank + 1} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(pending.transaction.txid) + " fee {pending.fee} size {pending.transaction.size}")
        for wallet := managed[]
            .log("BALANCE {wallet.name} {balance(wallet.address)}")

    void .process_event(string[] fields, string[] texts)
        now = int(fields[0])
        previous := mempool
        for pending := previous[]
            if now - pending.arrival >= params.expiry
                .drop(pending.transaction.txid, "expired")
        kind := fields[1]
        if kind == "PAY"
            .pay(fields)
        elif kind == "BUMP"
            .bump(fields[2], int(fields[3]))
        elif kind == "MINE"
            chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet wallet := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(named, fields[2])
            .mine(wallet)
        elif kind == "STATUS"
            .status(fields[2])
        elif kind == "PRINT"
            .print_state()
        else
            int peer_number := .peer(fields[2])
            if peers[peer_number].score >= params.ban_score
                peers[peer_number].ignored += 1
                .log("IGNORE {peers[peer_number].name} {kind}")
            elif kind == "TX"
                .receive_transaction(peer_number, chain.blocks.transactions.parse_transaction(fields[3]))
            else
                .receive_block(peer_number, chain.blocks.parse_block_event(fields, texts))

    string[] chain_lines()
        head := records[tip]
        lines := ["TIP {head.height} {head.hash} work {head.cumulative_work} stored {#records} orphans {#orphans}"]
        distinct<string> main_hashes
        rewards := 0
        fees := 0
        minted := 0
        for index := main_chain[]
            record := records[index]
            chain.blocks.Block block := record.block
            .main_hashes.add(record.hash)
            miner_name := "-"
            if record.height > 0
                chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet owner := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(owners, block.txs[0].outputs[0].address)
                miner_name = owner.name
                rewards += reward(record.height)
                fees += record.fees
                minted += block.txs[0].output_total()
            lines = lines.append("BLOCK {block.height} {block.hash} prev " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(block.previous) + " time {block.timestamp} bits {block.difficulty} nonce {block.nonce} txs {#block.txs} size {block.size()} fees {record.fees} miner {miner_name} source {record.source} work {record.cumulative_work}")
            for: position < int(#block.txs)
                chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction payment := block.txs[position]
                if payment.is_coinbase()
                    category := if block.height == 0 then "genesis" else "coinbase"
                    lines = lines.append("TX {position + 1} {payment.txid} {category} out {#payment.outputs} amount {payment.output_total()}")
                else
                    lines = lines.append("TX {position + 1} {payment.txid} payment in {#payment.inputs} out {#payment.outputs} size {payment.size} fee {record.transaction_fees[position - 1]}")
        int[] stale := []
        for: index < int(#records)
            if main_hashes.has(records[index].hash)
                continue
            position := int(#stale)
            stale = stale.append(index)
            while position > 0
                previous := records[stale[position - 1]]
                candidate := records[index]
                if candidate.height > previous.height or (candidate.height == previous.height and not text_before(candidate.hash, previous.hash))
                    break
                stale[position] = stale[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            stale[position] = index
        for index := stale[]
            record := records[index]
            lines = lines.append("STALE {record.height} {record.hash} prev " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(record.block.previous) + " source {record.source} work {record.cumulative_work}")
        for orphan := orphans[]
            lines = lines.append("ORPHAN {orphan.block.height} {orphan.block.hash} prev " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(orphan.block.previous) + " source {peers[orphan.peer].name}")
        for change := reorganizations[]
            lines = lines.append("REORG {change.moment} fork {change.fork_height} disconnected {change.disconnected} connected {change.connected} old " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(change.old_hash) + " new " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(change.new_hash))
        for wallet := managed[]
            count := 0
            coinbase := 0
            paid := 0
            for index := main_chain[1:][]
                record := records[index]
                if record.block.txs[0].outputs[0].address == wallet.address
                    count += 1
                    coinbase += record.block.txs[0].output_total()
                    paid += record.fees
            if count > 0
                lines = lines.append("MINER {wallet.name} blocks {count} coinbase {coinbase} fees {paid}")
        first := 1
        while first < int(#main_chain)
            last := first
            int bits := records[main_chain[first]].block.difficulty
            while last + 1 < int(#main_chain) and records[main_chain[last + 1]].block.difficulty == bits
                last += 1
            lines = lines.append("BITS {bits} heights {first}-{last} blocks {last - first + 1}")
            first = last + 1
        for name := peer_index.keys().sorted()[]
            int peer_number := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(peer_index, name)
            sender := peers[peer_number]
            state := if sender.score >= params.ban_score then "banned" else "ok"
            lines = lines.append("PEER {name} blocks {sender.accepted_blocks} rejected {sender.rejected_blocks} orphans {sender.orphaned_blocks} txs {sender.accepted_txs} rejected {sender.rejected_txs} ignored {sender.ignored} score {sender.score} {state}")
        MempoolEntry[] ranked := priority()
        for: rank < int(#ranked)
            pending := ranked[rank]
            lines = lines.append("MEMPOOL {rank + 1} {pending.transaction.txid} fee {pending.fee} size {pending.transaction.size} time {pending.arrival}")
        for key := rejections.keys().sorted()[]
            int count := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(rejections, key)
            lines = lines.append("REJECT {key} {count}")
        utxo_total := 0
        for coin := head.utxo.values()[]
            utxo_total += coin.amount
        lines = lines.append("SUPPLY genesis {records[0].block.txs[0].output_total()} rewards {rewards} fees {fees} burned {rewards + fees - minted} utxo {utxo_total}")
        return lines

    string[] balance_lines()
        lines := ["wallet,address,balance,immature,locked,incoming,utxos"]
        distinct<string> held := locked()
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo := records[tip].utxo
        for wallet := managed[]
            total := 0
            immature := 0
            locked_amount := 0
            count := 0
            incoming := 0
            for reference := utxo.keys()[]
                chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(utxo, reference)
                if coin.address != wallet.address
                    continue
                total += coin.amount
                count += 1
                if not mature(coin)
                    immature += coin.amount
                if held.has(reference)
                    locked_amount += coin.amount
            for pending := mempool[]
                for output := pending.transaction.outputs[]
                    if output.address == wallet.address
                        incoming += output.amount
            lines = lines.append("{wallet.name},{wallet.address},{total},{immature},{locked_amount},{incoming},{count}")
        return lines

    string[] utxo_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        string[] hashes := []
        total := 0
        distinct<string> held := locked()
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Coin> utxo := records[tip].utxo
        string[] references := []
        for reference := utxo.keys()[]
            position := int(#references)
            references = references.append(reference)
            while position > 0 and reference_before(reference, references[position - 1])
                references[position] = references[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            references[position] = reference
        for reference := references[]
            chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(utxo, reference)
            chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.Wallet owner := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(owners, coin.address)
            category := if coin.height == 0 then "genesis" elif coin.coinbase then "coinbase" else "payment"
            state := if not mature(coin) then "immature" elif held.has(reference) then "locked" else "free"
            line := "{reference} {owner.name} {coin.amount} height {coin.height} {category} {state}"
            lines = lines.append(line)
            hashes = hashes.append(chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.digest(line))
            total += coin.amount
        return lines.concat(["TOTAL {utxo.size()} {total}", "ROOT " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.merkle_root(hashes)])

    string[] history_lines()
        map<string, chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction> payments
        for index := main_chain[]
            for payment := records[index].block.txs[]
                .payments.set(payment.txid, payment)
        string[] lines := []
        for wallet := managed[]
            lines = lines.append("WALLET {wallet.name} {wallet.address}")
            count := 0
            spent_total := 0
            received_total := 0
            running_balance := 0
            for index := main_chain[]
                record := records[index]
                for payment := record.block.txs[]
                    spent := 0
                    received := 0
                    involved := false
                    for reference := payment.inputs[]
                        string[] parts := reference.split(":")
                        chain.blocks.transactions.Transaction earlier := chain.blocks.transactions.entry(payments, parts[0])
                        chain.blocks.transactions.Output output := earlier.outputs[int(parts[1])]
                        if output.address == wallet.address
                            spent += output.amount
                            involved = true
                    for output := payment.outputs[]
                        if output.address == wallet.address
                            received += output.amount
                            involved = true
                    if not involved
                        continue
                    count += 1
                    spent_total += spent
                    received_total += received
                    running_balance += received - spent
                    category := if not payment.is_coinbase() then "payment" elif record.height == 0 then "genesis" else "coinbase"
                    lines = lines.append("{record.height} " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(payment.txid) + " {category} spent {spent} received {received} net " + signed(received - spent) + " balance {running_balance}")
            pending_count := 0
            for pending := priority()[]
                spent := 0
                received := 0
                for reference := pending.transaction.inputs[]
                    chain.blocks.transactions.Coin coin := chain.blocks.transactions.entry<chain.blocks.transactions.Coin>(records[tip].utxo, reference)
                    if coin.address == wallet.address
                        spent += coin.amount
                for output := pending.transaction.outputs[]
                    if output.address == wallet.address
                        received += output.amount
                if spent != 0 or received != 0
                    pending_count += 1
                    lines = lines.append("pending " + chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.hashing.short(pending.transaction.txid) + " spent {spent} received {received} net " + signed(received - spent))
            lines = lines.append("END {wallet.name} txs {count} spent {spent_total} received {received_total} balance {running_balance} pending {pending_count}")
        return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

settings := Params([for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")])
node := Node(settings, chain.blocks.transactions.wallets.read_wallets("input/wallets.txt"))
events := read_lines("input/events.txt")
position := 0
while position < int(#events)
    fields := events[position].split(" ")
    int count := if fields[1] == "BLOCK" then int(fields[9]) else 0
    .node.process_event(fields, events[position + 1:<position + 1 + count])
    position += count + 1
bool output_exists := file.is_directory("output")
if not output_exists
    file.mkdir("output")
write_lines("log.txt", node.log_lines)
write_lines("chain.txt", node.chain_lines())
write_lines("balances.csv", node.balance_lines())
write_lines("utxo.txt", node.utxo_lines())
write_lines("history.txt", node.history_lines())

public import hashing = "./hashing.qui"

string address_of(string secret)
    return hashing.digest("addr:" + secret)[0:<16]

string sign(string secret, int index, string body)
    return hashing.digest("{secret}:{index}:{body}")[0:<16]

class Wallet(string name, string secret)
    address := address_of(secret)

Wallet[] read_wallets(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    Wallet[] result := []
    for line := lines[0:<#lines - 1][]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        result = result.append(Wallet(fields[0], fields[1]))
    return result
